// why: The embedded browser's <webview> guest bundle (guest preload + inspect bridge) is a THIRD compilation target beside main and renderer: it runs in a DOM context (needs the DOM lib) AND uses electron's ipcRenderer (needs node/electron types). It is deliberately outside tsconfig.node.json / tsconfig.test.json so its DOM lib never leaks into the main/preload/test program (a stray `/// <reference lib="dom" />` in a src/main file broke when-idle.test.ts exactly this way).
